title: Implement reactive compact recovery for context overflow
objective: Recover from prompt-too-long, context-window, and media-size provider errors by compacting and retrying the same query once instead of failing immediately.
implementation_scope: Detect recoverable prompt-too-long errors from CreateStream and stream-level provider events.
Detect recoverable media-size errors when represented by Go provider errors.
Withhold recoverable synthetic assistant errors from user output until recovery fails.
Run reactive compact against the exact messages used for the failed request, then retry the same query with post-compact messages.
Guard against repeated reactive compact attempts in the same query chain.
Bypass stop-hook or ordinary post-response logic when the model never produced a valid assistant response.
Surface the original withheld error if compaction fails or the retry still overflows.
out_of_scope: Do not implement context-collapse drain unless task_17 is already complete.
Do not add multi-retry compaction loops beyond the TS-equivalent single-shot guard.
acceptance_criteria: CreateStream prompt-too-long causes compact-and-retry, not immediate API call failure.
Stream-level prompt-too-long causes compact-and-retry without appending an invalid assistant response.
Second overflow surfaces a clear prompt-too-long error and does not spiral.
Media-size recoveries strip media for summary input and surface errors when preserved tail media still overflows.
risks: Provider error shapes differ; keep detection centralized and covered by fixtures.
Retrying after partial stream output must not leave orphan tool_use/tool_result pairs.
dispatch_prompt: Implement reactive context-overflow recovery in the Go query loop: detect prompt-too-long/media errors, compact, retry once, and surface only unrecoverable failures.
